title: Kannauji language - Wikipedia
text: Kannauji is an Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Kannauj region of the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. Kannauji is closely related to Hindustani, with a lexical similarity of 83-94% with Hindi. [2] Some consider it to be a dialect of Hindustani, whereas others consider it a separate Western Hindi language. [3] Kannauji has at least 9.5 million native speakers as of 2001.
